top_signals.title: Philippines Wants To Deepen Economic Ties With China
top_signals.summary:
Philippine Finance Secretary Frederick Go discusses Manila's economic ties with Beijing. He is in Hong Kong to conduct an economic briefing and speaks exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show.”
